name: TRADFRI LED driver, 10 w (ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-1)
config_flow_discovery_remarks: Select this profile only if the printed driver type is ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-1. The shared Home Assistant identifier may also match IL-2. Select the driver revision and connected load you actually have.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Select '1x NORRFLY 5W' only for an ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-1 driver connected to one NORRFLY 5W lamp. This profile estimates the complete assembly: the driver plus that one lamp. It applies only to this load, not to the lamp alone or any other driver load. Standby power is estimated.
